Reporting to the Accreditation Client Group Senior Manager, the Accreditation Client Group Manager is responsible for the day-to-day coordination, and delivery of accreditation services for assigned client groups for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Working within the established tournament accreditation framework, and in close collaboration with FIFA Zurich Accreditation, FIFA27 Accreditation teams and functional areas, the role ensures that client group accreditation requirements are delivered in line with defined FIFA accreditation policies, access control protocols, and agreed service standards. The role provides operational leadership to Client Group Coordinators and serves as the primary operational escalation point for assigned client groups.

Key Responsibilities

  • Client Group Management: Act as the primary accreditation point of contact for assigned client groups (e.g. safety & security, workforce, volunteers, suppliers, commercial partners).
  • Understand and manage client group accreditation requirements, volumes, timelines, and access needs in line with the overall accreditation framework and agreed milestones.
  • Coordinate the delivery of client group accreditation activities across all planning and operational phases.
  • Monitor readiness and proactively identify delivery risks, escalating issues as required.
  • Accreditation Process Delivery: Manage the end-to-end accreditation process for assigned client groups, including data collection, validation, access rights assignment, badge production, and distribution.
  • Ensure accurate application of access rights in accordance with approved zoning concepts, access matrices, and security requirements.
  • Coordinate accreditation activities and dependencies with Accreditation Operations, Systems, Security, and Venue teams.
  • Track application progress, volumes, and bottlenecks and implement corrective actions where required.
  • Team Leadership & Support: Lead, coordinate, and support Client Group Coordinators in the delivery of day-to-day accreditation activities.
  • Provide guidance on complex cases and ensure consistent application of processes across client groups.
  • Support onboarding, training, and knowledge sharing within the client group team.
  • Promote clear task ownership, prioritisation, and accountability.
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Communication: Work closely with FIFA and FIFA27 functional areas to support agreed accreditation requirements and timelines.
  • Communicate accreditation procedures, deadlines, and data requirements clearly and consistently to client groups.
  • Support the preparation and delivery of training sessions, briefings, and guidance materials.
  • Act as the primary operational escalation point for client group accreditation issues, escalating complex or cross-functional matters to the Client Group Senior Manager.
  • Event-Time Operations: Support the operation of Accreditation Centres and badge distribution points before and during the tournament.
  • Coordinate with Venue Operations, Security, and Accreditation Operations teams to resolve access-related issues quickly and effectively.
  • Provide operational decision-making support within defined authority during peak arrival and match-day phases.
  • Support on-site supervision of accreditation staff and workflows as required.
  • Reporting, Compliance & Continuous Improvement: Ensure all client group accreditation activities comply with FIFA accreditation regulations, data protection requirements, and security protocols.
  • Maintain accurate client group accreditation records, statistics, and issue logs.
  • Provide regular operational updates and reports to the Client Group Senior Manager.
  • Contribute to post-event reporting, lessons learned, and knowledge transfer activities.

Your Profile

  • University degree or equivalent higher education in Event Management, Sports Administration, Operations, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in accreditation, access management, client services, or operations within major international events.
  • Strong working knowledge of accreditation systems, access control concepts, and venue zoning models.
  • Experience working in large-scale, multi-stakeholder, and multicultural event environments.
  • Strong organisational and coordination skills with a high level of attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in high-pressure environments.
  • Clear and confident communicator with strong stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to identify issues early and escalate appropriately.
  • Team-oriented mindset with a strong focus on delivery and compliance.
  • Flexibility to work extended hours during peak tournament phases.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.

Desde a sua fundação, em 1967, passando por cada geração, até os dias atuais, todos procuram a São Carlos Saúde Oncológica com um único objetivo: o câncer. Nós já nascemos para cuidar do paciente oncológico.

Para isso, acreditamos no trabalho em equipe e investimos na composição de uma estrutura interdisciplinar em que o paciente e seus familiares encontram tudo o que precisam em um só lugar, 24h por dia. É o nosso conceito One Stop Care, que reúne Internação, Pronto Atendimento 24h, Quimioterapia, Radioterapia, bem como toda a parte de Medicina Nuclear (diagnóstica e terapêutica), Exames e Consultas com especialistas das mais diferentes áreas - todos voltados para a Oncologia.

Para nós, a vida vale muito. E por esse motivo, buscamos ressignificar o câncer e seu efeito nas vidas pessoas. Aqui, vamos além da doença e do tratamento em si. Encaramos o câncer de frente, como uma causa que precisa ser abordada sem tabu, sem medo e com muita coragem.

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

  • Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities

With operations in over 120 countries, we provide better solutions for our customers and richer opportunities for our people. As a leading partner to the energy industry, we're committed to achieving net-zero carbon emissions by 2050 and we're always looking for the right people to help us get there. People who are as passionate as we are about making energy safer, cleaner and more efficient.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Technology Consultant to join Global Manufacturing Excellence Digitalization and Technology Division(D&TD).

Global Manufacturing Excellence is the recognized Center of Excellence driving value across Saudi Aramco’s Downstream Global manufacturing portfolio. D&TD is responsible for leading the technology function collaborating across various downstream functions and corporate as well.

Your primary role is to support the development and deployment of technology management programs aimed at providing technical support across Saudi Aramco Global Manufacturing portfolio. You will ideate, introduce, deploy and sustain novel and innovative technological solutions within various domains including reliability, maintenance, sustainability, energy and process.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Develop comprehensive value adding technology roadmaps aligned to business challenges such as energy optimization, sustainability, plant availability, debottlenecking and process optimization.

  • Collaborate with technology providers in developing and conducting tailored training content and programs to support the implementation and adoption of technologies by end-users.
  • Recognize and introduce necessary changes to standards and governance.
  • Stay abreast of global and regional Oil and Gas industry trends, market conditions, and regulatory changes that may impact technology implementations.
  • Ensure compliance with corporate governance and standards, evaluate solution implementations. And identify necessary changes to standards and governance.
  • You will hold a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related field (Chemical, Industrial, Electrical, and Mechanical Engineering). A Masters’ degree is preferred.
  • You will have 10-15 years of experience as a Technology Consultant ideating, scouting, introducing and tracking value added technology deployment.
  • You have good understanding of downstream technologies, including but not limited to refinery processes.
  • You will have experience in developing business case and benefit/cost analysis for downstream technology.
  • You will have experience in working collaboratively in cross-functional teams, across the project lifecycle fostering effective communication and cooperation.
  • You will be able to demonstrate excellent understanding of management of change, engineering and design package as well as regulatory, risk mitigation and safety requirements.
  • You will have experience in change management, including developing and implementing technology changes.

Overview

The Principal Engineer will act as the Product Organisation's representative for the Brazil region and will serve as the primary point of contact for all ICM product related activities, with particular focus on Mechanically Lined Pipe products.

This role requires applying technical expertise to support the region in the advancement and promotion of Subsea7's Internal Corrosion Management products for client projects, new product development and continuous improvement initiatives.

The Principal Engineer will also manage communications and actions associated with clients and therefore must demonstrate strong collaboration and communication skills, engaging effectively with stakeholders at all organisational levels.

The role requires solid understanding of pipe manufacturing processes, pipeline fabrication and installation methods combined with significant theoretical and practical expertise in Corrosion Resistant Alloy materials and associated pipeline solutions.

Key responsibilities include providing technical and commercial product support for early engagement activities and project strategies, building and maintaining relationships with internal stakeholders, clients and suppliers, ensuring accurate technical communication, supporting product strategy definition, identifying and eliminating product cost of loss, providing support to Supply Chain Management, leading product development programmes and participating in Communities of Experts. The role will also gather and maintain regional market intelligence, regulatory updates and technological advancements relevant to ICM products.

Key Responsibilities

  • Product Technical and Commercial Support : Provide technical product information (including product design and operational envelopes) and commercially appropriate product recommendations and guidance to key stakeholders in support of early engagement activities and project win strategies.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration and Communications : Build and maintain relationships with key internal and external (clients and suppliers) stakeholders.

Provide clear and accurate product communications (verbally, written or via presentations), both technical and commercial, to internal audiences including senior management.

Ensure accuracy and alignment of product information across key internal stakeholders and externally with clients and suppliers.

  • Provide Input to Product Strategy: Work with the Product Director and Product Engineering Manager to ensure product roadmaps and team activities remain accurate and relevant to the region. In addition, the Principal Engineer will help maintain product trend analysis, SWOT analysis and competition analysis.
  • Eliminate Product Cost of Loss: Utilising information streams such as project feedback, Lessons Learned, product risk matrices, Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), Supplier Performance Incidents (SPIs), identify and execute opportunities for product improvements and to eliminate product associated cost of loss for future projects.
  • Supply Chain Support: Provide technical support to Supply Chain Management regarding suppliers of ICM pipeline products, including market assessments, leading qualification activities and facilitating discussions around product schedule, quality, cost, etc.
  • Lead Product Development Programmes: Ensure new products are developed, and introduced to the market, in line with Company processes and product strategy. In addition, lead product portfolio expansion projects such as new material selection and qualification.
  • Community of Experts (CoE) Participation : Participate and contribute in relevant CoE meetings. Provide product input and perspective for the purpose of the development of technical standards and specifications.
  • Product Related Market Intelligence: Gather regional product associated market information to support product team strategies. Maintain awareness of regional regulatory and client specification changes and product associated technological advancements.

Skills and Experience

  • Masters Degree qualified in relevant subject (ideally Materials - Metallurgy based).
  • Thorough understanding of pipe manufacturing processes, fabrication and installation methods.
  • Significant theoretical and practical understanding of CRA materials and associated pipeline solutions (in particular Mechanically Lined Pipe).
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills at all levels of the business. Ability to create and deliver reports and presentations.
  • Effective analytical skills, applies creative problem solving, will suggest and develop new methods and ways of working.
  • A collaborative worker who builds effective relationships across a highly diverse global business.
  • Self-motivated, takes ownership of responsibilities and works with minimum supervision, while also contributing to the wider team activities.
  • Pro-active planning and organising skills, able to identify and effectively prioritise workload and successfully meet multiple, competing deadlines.
  • Flexible to adapt to changing priorities within a fast-paced 24/7 global business.
  • Progressive thinking, pro-actively seeks to develop own learning and development.
  • Committed to continuous improvement and identification of efficient work methods and processes.
  • IT proficient across MS Office.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese.

title: Senior Project Manager Travel
description:
Senior Project Manager Travel

Department: Events & Entertainment

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Travel Project Manager oversees strategic travel planning, commercial management, and operations within the complex environment of a multi-stakeholder tournament.

This position plays a key role in ensuring the success of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027 by organizing and managing travel projects that provide safe, efficient, and dependable transportation for everyone involved in the event.

Responsible for turning FWWC27 event requirements into practical travel plans, the Senior Travel Project Manager works under tight deadlines and in collaboration with various stakeholders.

Collaboration, accountability, and operational excellence are central to this role, which involves close coordination with the FIFA Global Travel team, other functional departments, host country authorities, and selected travel service providers.

The Senior Travel Project Manager ensures all projects adhere to company policies, service standards, sustainability commitments, and risk management practices. They also anticipate dependencies, address operational risks, and drive progress on key milestones.

By using structured project management methods and competency standards, this role supports consistent outcomes, builds stakeholder trust, and delivers an exceptional tournament experience. Additionally, it contributes to knowledge sharing, ongoing improvement, and planning for future events.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic, Commercial & Financial Oversight

  • Ownership of tournament travel budget planning, cost benchmarking, and financial risk mitigation
  • Market benchmarking of airline/charter pricing to ensure competitiveness (RFP)
  • Identification, analysis, and escalation of pricing inconsistencies, capacity constraints, and commercial misalignments with airline and travel partners
  • Contribution to the development of travel rate cards, pricing frameworks, and commercial guidelines

Scenario Planning & Risk Management

  • Development of contingency plans for high level client groups
  • Proactive identification and mitigation of operational risk
  • Decision-making under high time pressure to ensure continuity of tournament operations while maintaining service levels and cost control

Senior Stakeholder & Executive Interface

  • Acting as an advisory interface between FIFA Functional Areas, External Stakeholders, Suppliers, Host Country Authorities, and FIFA/FWWC27 Senior leadership
  • Preparation of executive-level briefings, recommendations, and decision papers related to travel strategy, pricing, and operational readiness
  • Support to FIFA Partnerships in managing expectations with commercial partners in high-demand or capacity-constrained environments

Data, Systems & Process Governance

  • Oversight of travel-related data accuracy, reporting structures, and decision-support tools used throughout the tournament lifecycle
  • Ensuring transparency, traceability, and auditability of travel decisions, supplier selections, and cost structures
  • Contribution to the continuous improvement of FIFA travel handbooks, templates, operational playbooks, and systems

Tournament Scale & Complexity Management

  • End-to-end coordination of high-volume, multi-city charter and scheduled flight operations during tournament time
  • Ensuring consistent service delivery across multiple client groups (Teams, Delegates, Guests, VIPs, Workforce, FIFA/FWWC27 stakeholders)

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Completed (business) travel agency education or business education with training in the travel industry
  • Further education in tourism, event or general management

Experience

  • At least 5 years of experience in the business travel industry (travel, accommodation and ground transportation)
  • Excellent skills in GDS, preferably GDS Amadeus/ticketing and fare rules are a must
  • At least 2 years of experience in project and event management

Skills & Competencies

  • Experience in budgeting and accounting
  • Good negotiation skills
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese, additional languages beneficial
  • Practical commercial experience, distinguished geographical knowledge
  • Systemic and analytical thinking
  • Autonomy and sense of responsibility
  • Practical and process-oriented working profile with quality and efficiency
  • Intercultural competencies, Flexibility, adapting working processes to different cultures
  • Strong team player
  • Clear communication skills in different languages
  • Friendly and diplomatic behaviour to customers, team members and working colleagues
  • Capability to promote knowledge transfer with other team members
  • Service-oriented working style
  • Taking initiative and working proactively
  • Speedy delivery of short-term orders, respecting deadlines
  • Vision to predict potential problematical scenarios and anticipate solutions
  • Creativity to solve unforeseen issues
  • Solution-oriented operation

Certifications & Requirements

  • Strong GDS skills, with preference for Amadeus/ticketing and fare rules required

title: Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager
description:
Overview

Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027"). For the first time, it is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager reports to the Dressing and Signage Senior Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires an outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager is responsible for leading the venue branding, look and signage operations and delivery strategy from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. This position is responsible for overseeing the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™, ensuring that the look and feel is up to FIFA quality standards.

The role assumes event operational proficiency, venue dressing, signage and wayfinding knowledge with project management skills to directly oversee the dressing implementation at four FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ stadia. They will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met within their sites and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team. They will oversee contracted provider operations within their sites, ensuring that all are managed successfully and efficiently while monitoring budgetary spending within agreed limits. They will ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team. The role will collaborate closely with other dressing, signage, wayfinding and non-competition managers to maximize creativity and ensure consistency across all stadiums.

Key Responsibilities

  • Overseeing the turnkey planning of dressing and signage implementation across all official sites during planning phase, and stadium dressing for 3-5 stadia closer to the tournament.
  • Collaborating with the other Stadium Dressing Managers and ensuring that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament stadiums.
  • Working closely with the Non-Competition Dressing Managers and the Wayfinding and Signage Managers as well as other Functional Area Managers, to maximize efficiencies across the wider project.
  • Being the focal point for all general stadium dressing questions or requests from the Head of Department.
  • Oversight of contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all stadiums within the assigned sites.
  • Constant monitoring of the budgetary impact of dressing operations and reporting updates to the Senior Manager and Head of Department regularly.
  • Providing strategic input into the stadium dressing planning process and offering expertise when required.
  • Adhering to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department.
  • Daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimized at all stages of the project.
  • Liaising with stadium owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans.
  • Presenting to senior team members, management and other FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ functional areas as and when required.
  • Attending department-specific and organization site visits at assigned stadiums and other stadiums or official sites.
  • Inputting into the site-specific dressing strategies utilizing expertise from previous events and directives from management.
  • Acting as the main stadium dressing point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers within the assigned sites during the implementation phase of the project.
  • Participating in the creative design process for stadiums within the assigned sites.
  • Assisting with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required.
  • Ensuring the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against within the assigned sites.
  • Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities.
  • Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months in to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods.

Your Profile

  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. or a minimum 2 years’ experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive dressing or signage related activities.
  • A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.).
  • Strong understanding of stadium look and feel requirements and large-scale temporary installations.
  • Budget management experience on complex and multi-faceted events and projects.
  • Experience in managing providers of services for world-class events.
  • Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events.
  • Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential.
  • The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on-site attendance during the tournament period.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: LNG Economist - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview

We are seeking an LNG Economist to join Strategy & Business Development Division (SBDD) within the Gas Venture Department.

SBDD is responsible for sourcing and developing international gas value chain (upstream, liquefaction, marketing, regasification) investment opportunities. The Division is also responsible for coordinating the execution of these investment opportunities and managing investments post transaction, with an objective of creating a viable, material integrated global gas business by 2035.

Your primary role, as part on the economics modeling team, is to support the commercial business development team who develops the supply side of the LNG business and will lead the economic evaluation of LNG projects in terms of plant investment and offtake trading for investment decision making. Additionally, you will be required to engage with support functions such as Treasury, Group Finance and Strategy & Market Analysis as part of the model sign-off and due diligence process.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Provide analysis of potential joint ventures and mergers and acquisitions primarily in LNG and Upstream opportunities and responsible economic and financial modeling on an unlevered and levered basis
  • Handle complex deal structures, with the development and interpretation of data used in a highly technical and confidential analysis platform.
  • Provide sound investment analysis advice in support of LNG and Upstream Projects for Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) deals, by leading economic evaluations and financial due diligence in the deal making process
  • Provide professional and technical expertise for the analysis and solution of complex problems in all areas of financial modeling and economic analysis.
  • Validate and review of seller’s models on opportunities related to Upstream and LNG, identify potential problems and recommend solutions.
  • Provide analysis to fully understand and articulate economic value drivers to management.
  • Examine and prepare variance analysis of economic assumptions and high-level technical inputs with functional engagement support.
  • Provide support in preparation of management presentations for progression of deals through the stage gate process.
  • Assist in the formulation and implementation of economic analysis, policies and procedures to prevent or resolve problems and follow-up implemented changes to ensure the problem has been resolved.
  • Ensure that the company standards and processes are reflected in capital projects progression, project evaluations and in analysis of the business and environment through the stage gate process.
  • Train and develop junior professional analysts

As the successful candidate you will have:

  • Bachelor degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or Business. An advanced degree is preferred.
  • You will have a minimum of 15 years of related financial modeling work experience, preferably in an investment banking environment or a major petrochemical or energy industry corporation.
  • You will also have experience with Economic Evaluations, Cash Flow & Variance Analysis, structured finance, project finance and/or financial modeling.
  • You will be able to conduct Monte-Carlo stochastic risk analysis and VB excel modelling.
  • You will also be able to quickly establish credibility in the position and to effectively interact with all levels of management, including senior leadership.
  • You will have the capability to work effectively within a matrix organization and with multi-disciplinary teams.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
About the Job

zerohash is looking for an experienced and passionate Site Reliability Engineer to join our Platform team.

Responsibilities

  • Take an active role as co-owner of production services to ensure they are built, maintained, and operated in a reliable and scalable way.
  • Be part of the successful delivery of new features and services, as well as the day-to-day operations of existing services.
  • Collaborate with Software Engineering to identify and help drive operational improvements through metric driven collection and analysis.
  • Develop and maintain performance benchmarks for our applications to ensure a consistent customer experience
  • Help drive operational efficiencies releasing code and monitoring performance.
  • Provide traditional SRE/Operational support scopes like tooling and automation, monitoring, workflow management, maintaining and improving CI/CD, etc.
  • Participate in our weekly on-call rotation to investigate and resolve potential system issues.
  • Get your hands dirty managing and scaling our various infrastructure systems.

Requirements

  • You have extensive experience deploying, managing and troubleshooting infrastructure in AWS.
  • You have managed the full lifecycle of deploying a container to a production environment using self-managed kubernetes, ECS, or EKS.
  • When the perfect tool wasn’t available you wrote one yourself and taught others how to use it.
  • You understand CI/CD and have built custom tooling to deploy code to production environments.
  • You are able to solve problems in distributed Linux systems and are comfortable tracing requests across applications, systems and networks.
  • You hold a CKS certification (kubernetes security)
  • You can automate routine tasks and are proficient in at least two programming languages.
  • You have fantastic communication skills in both spoken and written forms to explain complex ideas to various audiences.
  • You thrive in an environment where collaboration and communication are paramount but are able to solve problems on your own.

Projects you might work on:

  • Creating and maintaining application performance benchmarks so we know when our applications are not performing well.
  • Improving our CI/CD pipeline to reduce the time it takes from development merge to production deployment
  • Continue to improve and scale our AWS and application infrastructure.
  • Work closely with software development to help optimize local development workflow.
  • Identify common issues and come up with solutions on how to reduce their impact or remove them altogether.
  • Help implement a scalable solution for blue/green and canary deployments.

Benefits

  • Healthcare Insurance: zerohash covers roughly 100% of employee premiums as well as a portion of spouse/children (U.S. only)
  • Vision & Dental Insurance (U.S. only)
  • Chance to earn equity
  • Maternity & Paternity leave (after 6 months)
  • WeWork All Access Membership
  • WFH Yearly Stipend
  • L&D Yearly Stipend (after 6 months)

About zerohash

zerohash is the leading crypto and stablecoin infrastructure platform and the operating system for digital money, powering the next generation of financial services. Founded in 2017, zerohash enables banks, brokerages, fintechs, and payment companies to offer crypto trading, stablecoin payments, and tokenized assets without having to build or manage complex blockchain infrastructure on their own.

The zerohash platform supports three core pillars: Trade, Transact, and Tokenize. Through a single integration, customers can launch regulated crypto buy, sell, and custody services; enable 24/7 stablecoin-based funding, payouts, and settlement; and issue and manage tokenized assets with built-in compliance, risk controls, and reporting. By abstracting away technical, regulatory, and operational complexity, zerohash allows partners to treat digital assets as just another financial primitive: fast, programmable, and global.

zerohash is trusted by some of the world’s most recognized financial and consumer brands, including Interactive Brokers, Morgan Stanley, Stripe, Franklin Templeton, BlackRock, DraftKings, Gusto, Worldpay, Kalshi, One Pay, among others. Today, zero infrastructure supports millions of end users across brokerage, wealth, payments, and marketplace platforms globally.

The company is deeply regulated and compliance-first, operating across the U.S. and internationally with licenses and approvals that allow partners to enter crypto and stablecoins with confidence. zerohash has become a trusted partner for enterprises seeking to modernize financial products while meeting the highest standards for security, risk management, and regulatory oversight.

To date, zerohash has raised over $280 million in funding from a mix of leading venture firms and strategic investors, including Morgan Stanley, Interactive Brokers, SoFi, Point72 Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and more.

zerohash has been featured in top-tier media outlets such as Bloomberg, CNBC, The Wall Street Journal, Financial Times, Reuters, Forbes, and CoinDesk, and its leadership team regularly contributes to global conversations on the future of payments, investing, and financial infrastructure.

At zerohash, we\'re building the infrastructure that makes digital money work securely, compliantly, and at global scale.

The zerohash Culture

All zerohash employees are guided by the following characteristics and core principles:

  • Independence/Ownership - An ability to work autonomously. Join zerohash, pitch ideas, and shape the work you do.
  • Passion - We are innovating quickly and challenging the status quo. We want you to think big, be creative and make a difference every day.
  • Collaborative - A good attitude and respect for others. We’re teammates, not co-workers. Everything we do is a shared success and equally a shared failure - we talk in terms of “we” not “me”.
  • Initiative - An ability and passion for learning and asking questions. We will champion you, challenge you and push you to achieve your best - and we expect you to do the same.
  • Empathy - An ability to listen, respect, and understand your co-workers, customers, and everyone you interact with no matter how different they are to you.
  • Adaptability - An ability to respond quickly. We are in a fast-paced industry and so we expect you to be creative when solving a new problem and comfortable under pressure.
  • Transparency - We believe that transparency is critical to empowering everyone to make the best decisions, both the company to its people and vice versa.
  • Integrity - Integrity creates trust. As both an organization collectively and as individuals, it is our most valuable asset.

Follow us

For candidates based in Colorado, please contact colorado-wages @zerohash.com to request compensation and benefits information regarding a particular role(s). Please include with your email the city you reside (or intend to reside in Colorado) and the title/link to the roles you\'re interested in.

**We’ve recently seen an increase in individuals impersonating zerohash recruiters to target job seekers. Please stay vigilant and keep the following in mind to ensure you are communicating with the real zerohash team:

  • Verified Emails Only: Official outreach will only come from a @zerohash .com email address.
  • No Messaging Apps: We will never contact you via unsolicited text messages, WhatsApp, or Telegram.
  • Official Applications: Only apply directly through our careers webpage (zerohash.com/careers) or zero-hash.breezy.hr.

See something suspicious?
If you want to verify an interview request or report a fake job posting or suspicious communication, please contact us immediately at talent @zerohash.com. This email is for fraud reports only. Candidate application inquiries will not be responded to.

Overview

Are you a self-starter with strong networking and virtualization skills, who thrives in a dynamic environment and is passionate about technology? If so, you will find this role as a Services Provider (MSP) Systems Engineer an exciting opportunity to collaborate with a dedicated team, contribute to innovative solutions, and drive the growth of managed service offerings across the AMER region.

About The Team

The Services Provider (MSP) team at Nutanix is focused on delivering comprehensive solutions tailored to service providers across the Americas. This dynamic team thrives on collaboration, innovation, and creativity, fostering a culture where experienced professionals operate independently while also supporting one another. The mission of the MSP team is to enhance the delivery of Nutanix\'s cutting-edge technologies in the managed services landscape, ensuring that partners receive the support and resources needed to succeed in a competitive market.

You will report to the Manager for Channel SEs in the Americas region, who champions a supportive leadership style aimed at removing barriers for team members and empowering them to execute their roles effectively. The work setup for this role is hybrid, allowing flexibility in where you work, with expectations of being in the office for part of the week; however, specific days for in-office work have yet to be determined.

The travel requirements for this role are expected to be around 40% initially, with the potential to increase to 50% or even 60% as the region becomes busier. This translates to approximately 1 to 3 days of travel per week, although much work can effectively be accomplished via virtual meetings, minimizing the need for constant travel.

Your Role

  • Provide technical presales support to MSP sellers and partners, addressing inquiries and facilitating solutions.
  • Conduct proposal development and sizing based on partner data to drive business initiatives.
  • Organize and manage proof of concepts (POCs) and demonstrations for partners.
  • Collaborate with specialists and internal teams to develop comprehensive technical strategies.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships within partner networks to foster community engagement.
  • Achieve set performance metrics and contribute to over-quota results in managed services offerings.
  • Support team growth by identifying the need for additional resources based on workload and performance.
  • Foster a culture of innovation and continuous learning by experimenting with new technologies and processes.
  • Work with the Nutanix Regional SE Manager to drive field pre- and post-sales alignment and engagement with partners.
  • Invest time and effort to learn new technologies to help our partners adapt their solutions and integrate your knowledge into their efforts.
  • Subject matter expertise in one or more relevant technology disciplines to establish credibility with technical leaders.

What You Will Bring

  • 3–5 years of presales experience in the Service Provider space or Systems Integrators and 5 years of customer-facing and/or technical experience.
  • Strong networking and virtualization skills.
  • Experience with public cloud technologies, specifically AWS and Azure.
  • Knowledge of AI and Kubernetes is a plus.
  • Knowledge of storage technologies and multi-tenancy architectures.
  • Familiarity with automation, scripting, and application blueprinting technologies (e.g., Ansible, Terraform).
  • Understanding of cloud-native technologies and security practices.
  • Confident public speaking and exceptional relationship-building skills.

title: OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect
description:
The OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect is responsible for designing and implementing the technical components of the organization's cybersecurity strategy. This role involves creating secure systems and network architectures, selecting and configuring security technologies, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure the organization's digital assets are adequately protected.

  • Develop and implement OT cybersecurity architectures tailored for renewable energy production and operations.
  • Design secure and scalable network architectures for OT environments, including SCADA, ICS, and IoT systems.
  • Ensure OT security strategies align seamlessly with corporate IT and cybersecurity policies, while also adhering to industry standards, including IEC 62443 and ISO 27001.
  • Implement and supervise cybersecurity tools, including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and vulnerability scanners, in OT environments.
  • Monitor and respond to OT security incidents, collaborating with incident response teams.
  • Collaborate with GRC team to address regulatory requirements.
  • Work closely with engineering, operations, and IT teams to integrate security into the lifecycle of OT assets.
  • Provide cybersecurity training and awareness programs for staff working with OT systems.
  • Engage with external vendors and partners to ensure secure deployment of third-party OT solutions.
  • Stay updated on emerging cybersecurity threats, trends, and technologies relevant to OT environments.
  • Develop and implement strategies for continuous improvement of OT cybersecurity posture.
  • Lead pilot projects and proof-of-concept initiatives for new cybersecurity technologies.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCES

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in cybersecurity, with at least 2 years focusing on OT environments (e.g., SCADA, ICS).
  • Deep knowledge of OT systems and protocols, including Modbus, DNP3, OPC, and MQTT.
  • Proficiency with cybersecurity frameworks like IEC 62443, NIST CSF, and MITRE ATT&CK for ICS.
  • Familiarity with firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and endpoint protection in OT environments.
  • Strong understanding of networking principles (e.g., VLANs, VPNs, routing).
  • Experience in renewable energy or other critical infrastructure industries is a plus.
  • CISSP, GICSP, CISM, or equivalent certifications preferred.
  • Proficiency both in Portuguese and English.
  • Availability for international travels.

KEY SKILLS

  • Strategic vision
  • Problem-solving and organizational skills.
  • Strong ability to articulate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Proficiency in building relationships with internal and external partners to drive cybersecurity initiatives.
  • Resilient
  • Strong attention to detail to ensure precision in designing, implementing, and auditing cybersecurity measures.
  • Flexibility to respond to evolving cybersecurity threats and technological advancements.

Business Analysts at Nubank
As a company at the forefront of the financial revolution in Brazil, Nubank has experienced exponential growth since its inception. To keep your growth path healthy, numerous critical decisions constantly need to be made. Business Analysts are fundamental in the decision process because they must not only be able to deal with large amounts of information and data, but also always think of ways to improve our clients' experience. It is BA's responsibility to structure the data, analyze it and use the results to test different solutions with the aim of improving Nubank's efficiency. You can read more about it in our blog and get some insights into how we work.

As a Business Analyst, You’re Expected To

  • Do a lot of investigative work, focused on deciding which data makes the most sense to use in which situation. If you don't have the data, it's your job to think about what tests can be done or how to extract the information you need to answer your questions;

title: Especialista em Contratos de TI
description:
Junte-se a uma das maiores empresas de serviços de TI do mundo! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira!

Por que se juntar à TCS? Aqui na TCS, acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença. Por isso, cultivamos uma cultura de aprendizado contínuo, repleta de oportunidades de aprimoramento e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias com as ferramentas certas, contribuindo para o nosso sucesso em um ambiente colaborativo.

Estamos buscando um Especialista em Contratos de TI , que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira, em um contrato CLT, híbrido no Rio de Janeiro - RJ .

Descrição do cargo

O Especialista em Contratos de TI é responsável por garantir previsibilidade e eficiência na gestão do portfólio de contratos do programa, atuando como elo estratégico entre Áreas Requisitantes, Engenharia/Arquitetura, Jurídico e Suprimentos (Procurement). A missão combina planejamento de demanda (forecast e capacity planning), definição e implementação do processo de Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) ponta a ponta (da requisição à aprovação, execução, medição, renovação e encerramento), governança contratual, compliance e mitigação de riscos, além de negociações complexas com grandes vendors. O papel também sustenta relatórios e dashboards executivos (Power BI/Excel) para visibilidade de demandas, prazos e riscos, apoiando decisões e otimização contínua.

  • Gestão do Ciclo de Vida de Contratos (CLM): Gerenciar desde a minuta inicial (RFP) até a renovação ou encerramento, garantindo que não haja expiração não planejada de licenças críticas.
  • Mitigação de Riscos: Identificar e neutralizar cláusulas abusivas, riscos de lock-in tecnológico e garantir conformidade com LGPD/GDPR e normas de segurança da informação nos contratos.
  • Monitoramento de Performance (Vendor Management): Acompanhar KPIs e SLAs dos fornecedores, aplicando penalidades ou créditos de serviço (Service Credits) quando necessário.
  • Otimização de Custos: Atuar proativamente na consolidação de contratos e negociação de volume para redução de OPEX.
  • Interface Técnica-Jurídica: Traduzir requisitos técnicos complexos (ex: métricas de consumo de Cloud) para termos contratuais claros e protegidos juridicamente.
  • Compliance e Auditoria: Assegurar que todos os contratos de TI estejam auditáveis e em conformidade com as políticas corporativas de governança (Compliance).
  • Inglês Fluente (Mandatório): Capacidade avançada de negociação contratual e revisão de cláusulas jurídicas em inglês (Legal English será testado).
  • Gestão de Contratos de TI: Experiência comprovada em minutas e gestão de contratos específicos de TI (SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, Licenciamento Perpétuo e Serviços Gerenciados).
  • Conhecimento de "Legal Tech": Familiaridade com termos jurídicos aplicados à tecnologia (Indenização, Propriedade Intelectual, Limitação de Responsabilidade, Data Privacy).
  • Negociação Estratégica: Domínio de técnicas de negociação (ex: BATNA) para lidar com grandes fabricantes de software e hardware.
  • Ferramentas de Gestão: Experiência com sistemas de gestão de contratos (CLM) e ERPs (SAP Ariba, SAP MM ou Oracle Procurement).
  • Análise de Dados: Habilidade com Excel para análise comparativa de propostas comerciais e controle de renewal dates.
  • Atenção aos Detalhes: Capacidade de analisar minutas extensas e identificar "pegadinhas" ou inconsistências em cláusulas e anexos técnicos.
  • Comunicação Assertiva: Habilidade para impor limites aos fornecedores e, ao mesmo tempo, manter um relacionamento de parceria (partnership).
  • Resolução de Conflitos: Atitude diplomática, mas firme, para resolver disputas de faturamento ou falhas de entrega de serviço com fornecedores.
  • Visão Sistêmica: Entender como um atraso na assinatura de um contrato pode impactar o cronograma de um projeto crítico de TI.
  • Ética e Integridade: Postura inquestionável em relação a Compliance e políticas anticorrupção.
  • Background Jurídico: Formação em Direito com especialização em Direito Digital ou Contratos.
  • Certificações: CCCM ou certificações em gestão de compras (CIPS).
  • Conhecimento em Licenciamento de Software: Entendimento profundo das métricas de licenciamento de grandes players (ex: Oracle Processor Core Factor, Microsoft M365 models).
  • Métodos Ágeis em Contratos: Experiência com Agile Contracts (contratos flexíveis baseados em entregas e não em escopo fechado).
  • Espanhol Avançado: Para suporte a operações na América Latina.
  • Gestão Estratégica do Ciclo de Vida (CLM): Assegurar a gestão ponta a ponta dos contratos de TI, desde a concepção (RFP) até a renovação ou descontinuação, garantindo que nenhum serviço crítico sofra interrupção por falhas administrativas e evitando renovações automáticas indesejadas.
  • Mitigação de Riscos Legais e Operacionais: Analisar minuciosamente minutas contratuais para identificar e neutralizar cláusulas de risco (ex: Vendor Lock-in, multas abusivas, limitações de responsabilidade desproporcionais), blindando a organização contra passivos futuros.
  • Gestão de Performance de Fornecedores (Vendor Management): Monitorar rigorosamente o cumprimento de SLAs (Níveis de Serviço) e KPIs, instrumentando a aplicação de créditos de serviço ou penalidades quando as entregas técnicas não corresponderem ao contratado.
  • Otimização de Custos (Cost Avoidance/Savings): Atuar proativamente na negociação de renovações e consolidação de contratos, buscando eficiências financeiras e redução de OPEX através da revisão de métricas de licenciamento e eliminação de softwares redundantes (Shadow IT).
  • Tradução Técnico-Jurídica : Atuar como o elo de ligação entre Engenharia, Jurídico e Suprimentos, traduzindo requisitos técnicos complexos (especialmente em Cloud e SaaS) para termos contratuais claros, garantindo que o escopo técnico esteja juridicamente protegido.
  • Conformidade e Governança : Garantir que todas as aquisições de tecnologia estejam em total conformidade com as políticas internas de Compliance, Segurança da Informação e normas de proteção de dados (LGPD/GDPR).

title: Instrumentation Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat family relocation package.

Job Overview

We are seeking an Instrumentation Engineer to join Abqaiq plants operation departments (APOD) specifically System support unit (SSU).

SSU is responsible for providing effective and proactive instrumentations, control and safety systems support to safeguard assets while adopting best industry practices and cutting-edge technologies.

Your primary role is to design, develop, and implement effective instrumentation solutions to assess current challenges and develop a mitigation plan by implementing cost‑effective solutions and deployment of advanced and proven technologies to ensure the reliability and efficiency of our assets.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate, you will be required to perform the following:

  • Perform periodical analytical studies of instrumentation system performance to overcome challenging operational programs.
  • Research and deploy emerging technologies related to instrumentation and control systems.
  • Act as an expert instrumentation and control systems resource for asset integrity management and risk assessment.
  • Develop Instrumentation and Control Plans (ICP) aligned with the organization's integrity performance objectives, assigning responsibilities, and timeframes for the responsible stakeholders.
  • Develop annual maintenance schedules for instrumentation systems in line with the ICP recommendations.
  • Review instrumentation system trends and initiate detailed engineering studies accordingly (e.g., increase in instrument failures, degradation of system performance, etc.).
  • Update the ICP based on the schedule maintenance and modifications.
  • Ensure instrumentation system obsolescence are addressed by the relevant process owners and track recommendations.
  • Facilitate the investigation of instrumentation system failures and deploy lessons learned from the root cause analysis to the system to avoid reoccurrence.
  • Coordinate the updating of the instrumentation system risk register and ensure timely review upon occurrence of incidents in the industry or other similar facilities to reflect that in the risk register and identify applicable systems.
  • Perform periodical analytical studies of assessment findings to overcome challenging operational programs.
  • Evaluate the maintenance findings and perform periodical analytical studies of assessment findings to overcome challenging operational programs.
  • Provide consultation on specialized areas related to instrumentation and control systems.
  • Perform instrumentation system analysis studies to assess current challenges.
  • Review instrumentation system data and make recommendations/reports accordingly.
  • Apply instrumentation system maintenance programs to ensure the integrity and reliability of the plant assets.
  • Oversee instrumentation system modifications, such as calibration, repair, and replacement, to prevent or minimize system threats.

As the successful candidate, you will have:

  • Qualifications: a Bachelor's degree in Instrumentation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field from a recognized and approved program. An advanced degree is preferred.
  • Experience: 15 years of experience in instrumentation engineering, including at least three years as a senior instrumentation engineer.
  • Knowledge: comprehensive knowledge of instrumentation principles, including measurement techniques, sensor technologies, and control systems.
  • Background: sufficient background in various instrumentation technologies, such as distributed control systems (DCS), programmable logic controllers (PLC), and supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) systems.
  • Standards: familiarity with instrumentation standards and codes, such as ISA (International Society of Automation) standards, API (American Petroleum Institute) standards, and IEC (International Electrotechnical Commission) standards, is a requirement.
  • Industry Experience: practical experience through entry‑level positions or instrumentation engineering roles in industries such as oil and gas, aerospace, chemical processing, marine, or infrastructure.
  • Skills: effective analytical and communication skills to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, prepare technical reports, and present findings to stakeholders.
  • Professional Development: awareness of the latest advancements in instrumentation technologies through professional development courses, certifications, workshops, conferences, and memberships in relevant industry organizations.
  • Knowledge of Standards: familiarity with Instrumentation Engineering standards within Saudi Aramco and international standards, such as ISA, API, and IEC.

Working environment

At Aramco, our people work on truly world‑scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. O Hospital Maternidade Maria Amélia Buarque de Hollanda integra a Rede de Atenção materno-infantil e ginecológica no Município do Rio de Janeiro. Suas ações tem por objetivo garantir a integralidade na linha de cuidado, visando a ampliação e qualificação do acesso humanizado das gestantes à assistência hospitalar. Seus processos e fluxos assistências estão ancorados no acolhimento com classificação do risco e em Diretrizes Clínicas baseadas em evidências que viabilizam a resolutividade e a qualidade na atenção prestada.

O Serviço possui papel estratégico na atenção perinatal em articulação com os demais serviços da Rede de Atenção à Saúde, articulada com a rede de atenção primária à saúde da AP 1.0 e regiões circunvizinhas.

  • Preparar e administrar medicações por via oral, tópica, intradérmica, subcutânea, intramuscular, endovenosa e retal, segundo prescrição médica, sob supervisão do Enfermeiro;
  • Receber e passar o plantão mantendo adequada comunicação entre as equipes;
  • Realizar o arquivo dos registros de enfermagem, conforme orientação do Conselho Regional de Enfermagem e Enfermeiro;

  • Realizar procedimentos assistenciais enfocando segurança e diminuição de riscos de infecção;
  • Participar de treinamentos e programas de desenvolvimento oferecidos pela Instituição;
  • Comunicar ao Enfermeiro defeitos em equipamentos e materiais e situações adversas que necessitem de intervenção;
  • Cumprir as normas e recomendações de Biossegurança, mantendo o ambiente seguro para o paciente e equipe multiprofissional;
  • Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição.

  • Possuir Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Possuir Curso Técnico de Enfermagem Completo;

Who You Are: Non-Negotiables & Must-Haves

Deal-Makers (You Need ALL of These):

✅ Competent & Smart - Can read an SOP, understand the intent, and execute it correctly. If a non-competent person and a competent person get the same instructions, the competent person comes back with zero questions and zero errors. You're that person.

✅ Detail-Oriented - You catch your own mistakes before submitting. You're accurate on first attempt (not "close enough").

✅ Able to Learn Quickly - New tool? New task type? You figure it out. You can absorb written instructions and apply them without constant hand-holding.

✅ Independent Worker - You don't need constant check-ins or motivation. You show up, execute, and report results.

✅ Reliable - You hit deadlines consistently. Your week-to-week output is predictable.

Deal-Breakers (Any of These = Not a Fit):

❌ Need constant hand-holding or detailed explanations for simple tasks

⚡ Speed - Speed creates room for unavoidable errors. We move fast, test quickly, and iterate relentlessly.

Ownership - Everyone makes mistakes, but we'll go further when we own them and learn from them. No excuses, just solutions.

Grit - The more hits you can take, the more unstoppable you become. We embrace challenges as opportunities to prove what we're made of.

Excellence - Good isn't good enough. We're doing operations right, and that requires excellence in everything we do.

You will deliver:

This job isn't glamorous. You won't be building YouTube strategies or closing clients. You'll be qualifying leads, updating spreadsheets, and managing databases. title: TÉCNICO DE ENFERMAGEM - CER CENTRO
description:
Descrição da vaga

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, o PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Valores

  • Profissionalismo
  • Qualidade
  • Responsabilidade Social
  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Ética

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar os procedimentos técnicos e assistenciais de sua responsabilidade, no setor da Urgência e Emergência do CER CENTRO, preenchendo registros específicos da Assistência de Enfermagem, conforme orientação do Enfermeiro, acolhendo os pacientes de modo que sejam atendidos continuamente em suas necessidades.
  • Realizar a conferência de material de enfermagem, bem como a reposição, esterilização, conferência e procedimentos dos mesmos;
  • Realizar acolhimento e atendimento individual para os processos de enfermagem;
  • Prestar cuidados gerais conforme orientação da equipe de enfermagem;
  • Reportar ao superior imediato e solicitar reposição/reparo de equipamentos danificados;
  • Registrar as atividades nos sistemas nacionais de informação, visando manter a segurança, qualidade e a continuidade do tratamento;
  • Manter organização do setor e murais de controle de atendimento;
  • Realizar, quando necessário, esclarecimento aos pacientes e/ou acompanhantes familiares quanto aos procedimentos aplicados ao paciente;
  • Atuar segundo preceitos éticos e legais estabelecidos por seu Conselho da Classe;
  • Atender a todos os princípios e critérios de conduta contidos no Manual de Conformidade Administrativa - Políticas e Princípios de Integridade da SPDM;
  • Executar as atribuições determinadas pela Instituição a respeito das práticas a serem tomadas em relação à proteção de dados pessoais - LGPD.
  • Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Possuir Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Possuir Curso Técnico de Enfermagem Completo;
  • Possuir Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Possuir experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Técnico de Enfermagem, no setor da Urgência e Emergência em unidades públicas, como UPAS ou CER

Informações adicionais

title: Standardized Patient
description:
Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Benefits

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Basic Function

The Standardized Patients (SP) are recruited either to simulate medical scenarios or to teach students essential clinical skills. Both roles basic function is to provide professional educational services to teach and assess health sciences learner. Training is mandatory and required to proceed with scheduling. SPs recruited to simulate medical scenarios are expected to portray the case with realism and accuracy. SPs will often be physically examined by students and faculty as part of the learning experience. SPs will recall information, complete a checklist, and provide verbal feedback to learners. SPs will be trained prior to all project participation. If an incumbent is recruited as an SP for teaching sessions, they will teach learners clinical techniques, including but not limited to history-taking, physical examination, communication, empathy, etc. These SPs must complete a rigorous initial training module as well as refresher training prior to all teaching sessions. During teaching sessions, SPs will engage learners by providing them step by step instructions on techniques as well as constructive feedback. SPs will use their body as the teaching tool.

All SP work is supervised by the SP Educator, Administrative Manager, Operations Manager and the Director of Simulation & Clinical Skills. Work hours will vary and are dependent upon course schedules. SPs are permitted a maximum of 58 hours per pay period and are requested to work a minimum of 25 hours per pay period, subject to course needs. SPs are not guaranteed any minimum number of hours.

Supervisory Accountability

None

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, students, and staff of the department and University.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Interest in education and contributing to the development of healthcare professionals.
  • Possess a positive and proactive mindset.
  • Simulate all aspects of scenarios, including history of current problem, affect/behavior and physical findings, in a standardized, accurate, and reliable manner.
  • Wear professional clinical attire for work assignments including a hospital gown with only appropriate undergarments, while on camera and/or observed live through an observation window or video monitor.
  • Accurately and consistently complete checklists at a 95% accuracy percentage.
  • Provide verbal feedback to learners using constructive feedback training.
  • Allow and be comfortable with having repeated physical examination maneuvers performed on body by learners and clinical faculty.
  • Accept ongoing feedback from supervisors to incorporate into case simulation.
  • Be willing to be audio and videotaped during simulations (onsite and virtual).
  • Demonstrate flexibility and reliability with work scheduling and assignments.
  • Follow written and verbal instructors from supervisors.
  • Demonstrate core values of professionalism when interacting with learners, faculty, supervisors, and peers.
  • Follow all Center and HU Policies and Procedures.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Leadership
  • Demonstrate professionalism and the ability to accept feedback from supervisors.
  • Demonstrate the ability to maintain diplomacy.
  • Demonstrate strong work ethic.
  • Interpersonal and Communication
  • Demonstrate the ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing with a diverse population.
  • Demonstrate effective positive communication skills in a positive and productive manner with faculty, students, and other users of the Center.
  • Demonstrate the ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students, and the general public.
  • Technical Competency
  • Demonstrate advanced knowledge of office and administrative practices and principles.
  • Demonstrate skill proficiency at operating computers and associated software applications.
  • Organizational Skills
  • Demonstrate effective organization, and planning skills.
  • Confidentiality
  • Demonstrate the ability to exercise discretion and ensure a high-level of confidentiality.
  • Demonstrate excellence in practice

Minimum Requirements

High School diploma or GED equivalent. Must be of legal status to work in the US. Must be computer literate and proficient. Must successfully complete initial HU Introduction to Standardized Methodology workshop for scheduling

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Pay Range: $20 per hour

description:
Visão geral

Somos gente que cuida de gente. Cada um com características, histórias e qualidades únicas, mas todos unidos pelo mesmo propósito: viver plenamente. Temos orgulho da nossa história, por isso fazemos o nosso melhor hoje, sem deixar de olhar para o amanhã.

Se você preza pela valorização humana, integridade, foco no cliente, superação de resultados, sustentabilidade, inovação em soluções em tudo o que faz, vem fazer parte do nosso time de gigantes.

Como é o ambiente de trabalho?

Oferecemos um ambiente em que todos são protagonistas e agentes de transformação. Temos um excelente clima organizacional com pessoas engajadas em entregar os melhores resultados, assim como grandes oportunidades de crescimento para você.

Vem conferir!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Cumprimentar os clientes de forma cortês e prestativa, ajudando a esclarecer dúvidas, fornecendo informações sobre produtos, incluindo dosagem, uso e possíveis efeitos colaterais.
  • Dispensação de Medicamentos: Dispensar medicamentos prescritos com precisão, seguindo os regulamentos e procedimentos da farmácia. Certificar-se de que os pacientes recebam as orientações adequadas sobre o uso de medicamentos.
  • Vendas e Registro de Vendas: Realizar vendas de produtos de venda livre e registrar as transações com precisão. Processar pagamentos em dinheiro, cartão de crédito ou outros métodos de pagamento aceitos pela farmácia.
  • Gestão de Estoque: Verificar regularmente o estoque de medicamentos e produtos, repor itens conforme necessário e garantir que os produtos estejam dentro do prazo de validade. Manter registros precisos de estoque.
  • Conhecimento de Produtos: Manter-se atualizado sobre os produtos disponíveis na farmácia, incluindo suas características, benefícios e possíveis interações medicamentosas.
  • Atendimento Telefônico: Atender chamadas telefônicas de forma profissional, responder a perguntas dos clientes.
  • Organização: Manter a área de atendimento ao cliente e as prateleiras organizadas. Garantir que produtos perigosos sejam armazenados adequadamente e de acordo com as normas de segurança.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Conhecimento em Informática Básica;
  • Desejável experiência como operador de caixa e atendimento ao cliente.
  • Disponibilidade de trabalhar em escala 6x1.
  • Experiência como operador de caixa e atendimento ao cliente.

Informações adicionais

  • Vale-transporte;
  • Plano de Saúde por elegibilidade por localidade e cargo;
  • Plano Odontológico por adesão;
  • Seguro de vida e Assistência Funeral;
  • Plataforma de terapia online;
  • Programa de Gestantes;
  • Convênios Educacionais com descontos exclusivos para colaboradores e dependentes;
  • Universidade Corporativa Pague Menos com cursos e treinamentos - Up Farma;
  • Desconto Ouro nas Farmácias Pague Menos;
  • Convênio Farmácia, com desconto em folha de pagamento - Epharma;

Não fazemos distinção de cor, religião, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade.

VEM SER GIGANTE, VEM TRABALHAR NA REDE DE FARMÁCIAS QUE É DO TAMANHO DO BRASIL

Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma, saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza!

Nossa história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE e por meio da valorização humana, da superação de resultados, do foco no cliente, da sustentabilidade, da integridade e da inovação em soluções nos tornamos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil.

Nosso modelo de negócios é baseado na venda de produtos e serviços voltados para a saúde e bem-estar dos nossos clientes. Atuamos no mercado de varejo de especialidade, seguindo o conceito de drugstore. Buscamos ser não somente uma rede de farmácias, mas um hub integrado de saúde. Desta forma, implementamos, a partir de 2016, o Clinic Farma, consultório farmacêutico o qual nossos clientes recebem, em salas equipadas e confortáveis, acompanhamento individualizado em seus tratamentos.

Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente.

Se você tem amor por servir e é gente que cuida de gente, vem ser Gigante! Aqui, quem acredita e trabalha cresce.

Overview

Quer fazer parte de uma das maiores redes de clínicas odontológicas do Brasil? Há mais de 39 anos no mercado, o Grupo Clínicas Inteligentes é uma das maiores redes de clínicas odontológicas. Presente em mais de 20 estados, o nosso grupo é formado por 4 marcas que contam com a colaboração de 2100 colaboradores e um dos melhores corpos clínicos do Brasil. Com conceito de clínica popular, somos determinados a garantir o pronto atendimento em ambientes seguros, confortáveis e climatizados por um valor justo e acessível. Nós do grupo Clínicas Inteligentes somos apaixonados pelo que fazemos. Acreditamos que o atendimento humanizado contagia e motiva a todos que se relacionam conosco. O Grupo Clínicas Inteligentes informa que sua participação em nossos processos seletivos é gratuita e nenhum fornecedor ou terceiro está autorizado a cobrar valores para candidatura à vaga, treinamento, material didático ou qualquer outra despesa relacionada.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Recepcionar pacientes no consultório dentário, procurando identificá-las e averiguar suas necessidades, para prestar informações ou encaminhá-las ao cirurgião dentista. Executar tarefas auxiliares ao trabalho do cirurgião dentista, visando a agilização dos serviços. Auxiliar o profissional, no atendimento aos pacientes, em tarefas tais como: segurar o sugador de saliva, fazer o afastamento lingual e alcançar materiais e instrumentos odontológicos. Fazer a manipulação de material provisório e definitivo usado para restauração dentária. Preparar o material anestésico, de sutura, polimento, bem como procede a troca de brocas. Fazer a separação do material e instrumentos clínicos em bandejas para ser utilizado pelo profissional, zelar pela boa manutenção de equipamentos e peças, preparar, acondicionar e esterilizar materiais e equipamentos utilizados. Colaborar com limpeza e organização do local de trabalho consultórios, sala de esterilização e infecção. Realizar o controle dos materiais no estoque, solicitação dos materiais via sistema e cotação de compra dos materiais emergenciais para as clínicas, realizar as Cefalometrias e as fotos para realizar a documentação de Ortodontia dos pacientes, quando necessário. Realização de procedimentos básicos junto aos pacientes (remoção de sutura, higiene oral, tomadas radiografias) sempre com supervisão do Dentista. Executar outras atividades correlatas ao cargo e/ou determinadas pelo superior.
